description: Calculates front-end (housing) and back-end (total) debt-to-income ratios from monthly income and monthly payments, and compares them with the published limits of Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA and USDA, automated and manual underwriting listed separately. Each limit carries its guideline citation (document, section, version, page, cite_as). With loan_amount, state and family_size it also returns VA's minimum residual income. Pure calculation: an estimate, not an underwriting decision.

alimony_child_support.description: Monthly alimony, child support and separate maintenance payments. Default 0.
alimony_child_support.title: Alimony Child Support

auto_loans.description: Monthly auto loan and lease payments. Default 0.
auto_loans.title: Auto Loans

credit_cards.description: Minimum monthly payments on credit cards and other revolving accounts. Default 0.
credit_cards.title: Credit Cards

family_size.description: Number of people in the household, for VA's residual income table.
family_size.title: Family Size

housing_payment.description: Proposed total monthly housing payment in dollars: principal and interest, property taxes, insurance, mortgage insurance and HOA dues.
housing_payment.title: Housing Payment

installment_loans.description: Other monthly installment loan payments. Default 0.
installment_loans.title: Installment Loans

loan_amount.description: Loan amount in dollars; selects VA's residual income table (below or from $80,000).
loan_amount.title: Loan Amount

monthly_income.description: Gross monthly qualifying income of all borrowers, in dollars.
monthly_income.title: Monthly Income

other_debts.description: Any other monthly debt payments, such as payments on other real estate. Default 0.
other_debts.title: Other Debts

residual_income.description: The borrower's monthly residual income by VA's method, compared with VA's minimum.
residual_income.title: Residual Income

state.description: Two-letter state code of the property, e.g. 'TX'; selects VA's residual income region.
state.title: State

student_loans.description: Monthly student loan payments as the agency counts them. Default 0.
student_loans.title: Student Loans

name: calculate_dti
title: Calculate debt-to-income ratios
